traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: The rasa's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 12). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components: * At will: mage hand, message * 1/day each: disguise self, silent image

traits.name: Mask of Shadows
traits.text:
The alley stalker has a mask
enchanted to make them a threat in shadowed
areas and when striking the first blow on an enemy.
The alley stalker has advantage on stealth checks
and its attacks against surprised enemies are always
considered a critical hit.

traits.name: Inscrutable Intentions
traits.text:
The rasa is immune to any
magical effects to determine if it is lying.

traits.name: Sight of the Rasa
traits.text:
The rasa share a special sight that
is invisible to all non-rasa creatures. As an action, a
rasa can touch a creature and place a secret mark
on that creature's chest. This mark lets other rasa
know whether or not this creature should be
regarded as a friend or a foe.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The rasa makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Poisoned Dagger
actions.text:
Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:
+5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target.
Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4)
poison damage.
